731:t_125:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That's right! Overcoming everything that gets in my way, my black wings will cut through causality!」

731:t_126:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$...! I end this here!」

731:t_126:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You can't kill me. So step aside.」

731:t_126:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Or will you offer up your life as well? To make me pile on more sin?」

731:t_126:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I carry sins of my own, too...」

731:t_126:4.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That's exactly why, with this life, I... will strike down whoever blocks the future...!」

731:t_126:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I pile sin on sin for my own sake, and you pile sin on sin for someone else's... We are beings who can never see eye to eye!」

731:t_127:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「I won't let you get away today! We settle this here, $$アサキム$$!」

731:t_127:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Even wings carrying your feelings can't catch up to $$シュロウガ・シン$$.」

731:t_127:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I will overcome causality! To fulfill my one and only wish!」

731:t_127:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「I refuse to be a sacrifice for that! Let's see which of us flies higher and faster, you or me - it's a showdown!!」

731:t_128:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Listen to my song! And then let out everything you're holding in your gut!」

731:t_128:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It would be fun if I could...」

731:t_128:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But I turn my back on it. Higher, faster... I spread my wings to overcome causality!」

731:t_129:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I intend to be. That's why I struggle.」

731:t_129:2.en:
$$レド$$
「If your goal is to defeat the $$御使い$$, why do you reject us!」

731:t_129:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It's pointless to tell you, who've gained a way to live as a human! I hunt you all for my own sake!」

731:t_130:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no intention of listening to selfish logic. If you're coming, come already!」

731:t_130:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Good. Between us, neither understanding nor sympathy is needed.」

731:t_130:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Hunter and hunted...! That is all there is!」

731:t_131:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$...! Don't tell me your goal is...」

731:t_131:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You seem to have noticed. Heh heh... As expected of you.」

731:t_131:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then we'll grant that wish of yours! We end you here!」

731:t_131:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You're going to talk about things you can't even do? Merely voicing a wish changes nothing!」

731:t_132:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You who don't die and I who can't die... It's because the two of us clash that this world is interesting.」

731:t_132:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Some seek eternity, and some hate it...」

731:t_132:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Perhaps you could overcome causality and kill me...」

731:t_132:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I hope so! That you have that much power!」

731:t_133:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I thought you, a $$特異点$$ tossed about by the multiverse, would be able to understand me too.」

731:t_133:1.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't know what circumstances you have, but I don't want to be counted as one of the gang by a guy who spreads misery over other people for his own goals.」

731:t_133:2.en:
$$桂$$
「That's right, $$アサキム$$! Let's settle what started in the $$多元戦争$$ right here!」

731:t_133:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Even if you're the key to saving the universe, I won't hesitate to hunt you...! I'll carve a new sin into my black wings!」

731:t_134:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「How anguished you are, $n. Have you made up your mind?」

731:t_134:3.en:
$n
「I'll do anything to take you down! I'll even stake my life!」

731:t_134:4.en:
$n
「But I'll win! There are things I have to live to do!」

731:t_134:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That's right... That's the natural way of the living, isn't it.」

731:t_135:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「You're really going through with it?」

731:t_135:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Do I need to put it into words?」

731:t_135:2.en:
$$メール$$
「You idiot, $$アサキム$$! Darling doesn't really want to fight! And yet...!」

731:t_135:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't say it, $$メール$$. Now that it's come to this, all we can do is fight.」

731:t_135:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't gloss it over with words like that! You and I both have reasons we can't back down, so we clash! That's all there is to it!」

731:t_135:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Here I come, $$アサキム$$! Full-power showdown so neither of us has any regrets!!」

731:t_135:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$ザ・ヒート$$... I will never forget meeting a man like you.」

731:t_136:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I've been waiting, $$セツコ$$. It was for this day that I've been giving you sorrow.」

731:t_136:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Chief and $$トビー$$ were sacrificed for that...」

731:t_136:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Do you hate me? Or do you pity me?」

731:t_136:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Neither...! As $c, I will fight those who stand in our way!」

731:t_136:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アサキム$$! Defeating you is my mission!」

731:t_136:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Sealing away your personal feelings with a sense of duty in order to fight... As I thought, you are the $$悲しみの乙女$$, $$セツコ$$.」

731:t_136:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「And it's that you I will hunt! That is the supreme moment I've waited so long for!」

731:t_136:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Be quiet, $$アサキム$$! I will never lose to you!!」

731:t_137:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
($$アサキム$$... You and I... Which of us will end up destroying the Heavenly Prison, I wonder...)

731:t_137:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The $c I bet everything on will surpass even your black wings. Let me show you.)

731:t_138:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Even with this many $$黒の英知$$ gathered, the road to $$太極$$ will not open...)

731:t_138:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The final key is the $$スフィア$$s after all...)

731:t_139:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$クロウ$$... You too wish to settle things with me.」

731:t_139:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「However I got it, the $$スフィア$$ of the $$揺れる天秤$$ is mine. I'm not about to hand it over to anybody.」

731:t_139:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm already crying poor over the debt alone. I'm done leaving a pointless debt collector alone.」

731:t_139:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You joke around, but you know the weight of what you carry.」

731:t_139:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Yeah, you're right. To take down the $$御使い$$, we'll surely need the power of the $$スフィア$$.」

731:t_139:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's why I can't hand it over! Not this thing, and not to a guy like you!」

731:t_139:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Good! Winning a $$スフィア$$ that shines with that strong will is what it's all about!」

731:t_139:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I told you already! Don't go thinking my belongings are yours!」
